name: android_run_instrumentation
description: Runs the on-device tests of an app (`am instrument`: Espresso, UI Automator, Flutter integration_test) and returns passed/failed counts with each failure's stack. The test APK must be installed (e.g. ./gradlew installDebugAndroidTest). The tests run your code and may change the app's data. Stops after timeoutSec.

package.description: The app under test, e.g. com.example.app.

runner.description: test.package/RunnerClass (default: the installed runner targeting package).

testClass.description: Only this class or method: com.example.LoginTest or com.example.LoginTest#signsIn.

timeoutSec.description: Stop the run after this many seconds (default 600).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
